definition.coverage_count: C(A)=#{i in 0,...,19:H_i is hit by support A}
definition.factorial_weight: for k>=1, each oriented first-reach boundary edge has weight (k-1)!(16-k)!; at k=0 the empty support has 16! completions
definition.prefix_support: A_k is the set of the first k labels
definition.random_object: uniform permutation of the sixteen frozen C88 labels
definition.trivial_target_convention: target 0 is hit by the empty support, so C(empty)=1 and K_1=0 deterministically
